title: Damn Opus is getting good at VFX!!!!!
author: AntiqueFeedback7447
selftext:
This is by far the best VFX i could get out of Opus until now!  
  
Currently working on a 3rd person character controller including animation editor and composer and just started layering in the VFX…..  
  
Daaamn Opus is cooking well these days!

1. Did describe what VFX types i want
2. Brief description/breakdown of each VFX
3. Prepared a style guide
4. Told it to do research
5. Added at end of prompt: “Spend lots and tons of crazy effort in researching, planning and implementing those effects! we aim for super high visual quality! lets goooo!”

Output is getting better and better!!!

comments.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
comments.body:
It even output a VFX sheet while testing!

https://preview.redd.it/wd5z9rezk8hh1.png?width=1800&format=png&auto=webp&s=bbe71682486d86aa21f681892487eea16d8f2ae8

comments.author: IdealEmpty8363
comments.body: What is the underlying engine/ tech being used?

replies.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
replies.body:
Just added it to the post body:  
\- Animation Editor, Composer and VFX built with r/ClaudeAI Opus 5  
\- r/meshyai for the neutral grey body mesh and rig,   
\- r/threejs for the cosmetics and gear items   
\- r/Adobe Mixamo for the Sword&Shield animation clips.   
  
No need for ultracode, no need for the infamous Gauntlet Loop. Well defined prompt + research + high effort is more than enough!

replies.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
replies.body:
Just added the info to the post body :) Animations are coming from the Mixamo Swords&Shield pack.   
I then built an Editor/Composer for animations on top of those clips, to mix and match animations into new clips and making them blend smoothly for combat, independent leg from upper body animations etc.

replies.author: AntiqueFeedback7447

Just added some more info to the post body. Its done using three.js, mixamo animation pack for the base animation clips, plus my own editor/composer where i can mix and match animation clips, create gear and cosmetic items to attach to the base body mesh etc. 

The editor/composer I built also with Opus 5, and its mostly TypeScript, React + React Three Fiber.

replies.author: AlarakReigns
replies.body: An easy way to do it depending on how your game works is a prop editor. It is manual editing work, but if you ask it to make a prop editor to attach weapons and armor if your game supports it, it will build a prop editor so you can manually stick things on and it only takes 1-5 minutes per item. I went from asking it to attach the props to it making an easy prop editor for me to attach things myself. My game is isometric so pre renders and baking is small so I have the liberty of my animations not being as clean or models.
